metadata.description: Video skills for Claude Code, loaded straight from their upstream GitHub repos. See docs/opus-5-5-video-repos.md.

plugins.name: remotion-skills

plugins.name: manim-skills

plugins.name: hypit
plugins.description: Direct and produce videos with Hypit: remix viral videos, swap faces, words and B-roll.

plugins.name: chengfeng-videocut
plugins.description: Video cutting, subtitles, visuals and export skills (Agentchengfeng/chengfeng-videocut-skills).

plugins.name: openmontage
